SELECT SDT.CARD_NO, SDT.ACTION, SDT.IMAGE_ID, SDT.GENERAL AS PERSON_NAME, SDT.CREATE_TIME FROM SMT_TASK_DOWN_RECORD SDT
SDT.DEVICE_TYPE = 1 AND SDT.ACTION = 1
AND SDT.DEVICE_CODE = #{query.deviceId}
AND SDT.GENERAL LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.name}),'%')
AND SDT.GENERAL LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.badge}),'%')
AND SDT.CREATE_TIME between to_date(#{query.startTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_date(#{query.endTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
ORDER BY SDT.CREATE_TIME DESC
